name: create_incident
description: Log a venue problem (power, wifi, lights, furniture, supplies, cleaning, lost and found) after the caller confirmed the location once. Never use for injuries, medical issues, fire, smoke, or safety threats: use escalate_to_human. Never use for blocked paths: use report_blockage.

location.description: Exactly one location label from the location list in your instructions, e.g. "Table 142", "Cartesia booth", "Fountain".

description.description: One sentence in the caller's words.

priority.description: How urgent for the hackers affected.

name: report_blockage
description: Report a blocked hallway, doorway, stairway, or path after the caller confirmed the location once. An operator confirms it before staff routes change.

location.description: Exactly one location label from the location list in your instructions, e.g. "Table 142", "Cartesia booth", "Fountain".

description.description: What is blocking it, in the caller's words.

name: escalate_to_human
description: Immediately hand off to a human operator. Use for any injury, medical, fire, smoke, or safety report (no location confirmation needed), when the caller asks for a person, or when the location cannot be pinned down.

reason.description: Why this needs a human, e.g. "someone fainted", "caller asked for a person".

location.description: Exactly one location label from the location list in your instructions, e.g. "Table 142", "Cartesia booth", "Fountain". Omit if unknown.

description.description: What the caller said, in their words.
